root_cause: Builtin ISel patterns in RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td pass the user value instead of the ISA encoding: int_riscv_pulp_clip used trailing0s(lowerBound) (=log2(-lo)) instead of trailing1sPlus1(upperBound) (=log2(hi+1)+1); int_riscv_pulp_bextract/bextractu passed Size into the width-minus-one field. Both from fork commit f1b7aebff8c2 (Federico Ficarelli 2022-08-25, [LLVM/PULP/SNITCH] Support for PULP and Snitch cores/platforms). Same defect class, same pattern block, same cluster, so fixed together per the conductor's scope addition.
fix: clip: (P_CLIP rs1, (trailing1sPlus1_pulp upperBound)), same xform as p.clipu, the idiom pattern and upstream CORE-V cv.clip (RISCVInstrInfoXCV.td:723,771 @llvmorg-20.1.8). bextract[u]: new TImmLeaf bitFieldWidth (1..32) + SDNodeXForm minus1, encode Size-1.

other_errors_seen: Sema (clang-builtins cluster, SemaRISCV.cpp:1416) does not require lo == -(hi+1) for __builtin_pulp_clip; GCC rejects e.g. clip(x,-4,15) ('expects ... Min=-2^(N-1), Max=2^(N-1)-1'). Clang accepts it and now encodes from the upper bound. The fork test llvm/test/CodeGen/RISCV/intrinsics/xpulpv.ll and clang/test/CodeGen/RISCV/riscv-xpulpv2-intrinsics.c use exactly such an inconsistent call (clip(-10,-4,15)); they pass (immediate is wildcarded). Separate task: add the Sema check like GCC.

Sema allows __builtin_pulp_bextract[u] Size=0 (range [0,32], SemaRISCV.cpp:1422); GCC rejects Size=0 ('Size>0'). Before this fix Size=0 silently extracted 1 bit; now it fails ISel ('Cannot select'). Separate clang-builtins task: tighten Sema range to [1,32].

Idiom patterns for p.clip/p.clipu (RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td def : Pat<(clip negativePowerOf2, powerOf2Minus1_pulp ...)> and betweenu) never match: the leaves are TImmLeaf, which only match TargetConstant, while smin/smax operands are plain constants. Plain-C clamps compile to li+p.max+li+p.min (correct, but slower than GCC's single p.clip). Missed optimization, not a miscompile; upstream CORE-V uses ImmLeaf. Separate task if wanted.

__builtin_bitinsert (fork-only, int_riscv_pulp_bitinsert) passes its size argument straight into p.insert's width-minus-one field; GAP9 GCC has no such builtin, so there is no oracle for its intended semantics. Not changed; owner to decide.

RISCVSubtarget.cpp:176 getMinRVVVectorSizeInBits, via TTI::getInstructionCost in SimpleLoopUnswitch (not caused by this change: it fires in a mid-level IR loop pass, before instruction selection, which the .td patterns cannot affect; likely codegen-core TTI).

ref-18 clang miscompiles/hangs a simple copy loop in the extended sim test's main (lp.setup hardware loop never exits on GVSoC); worked around with optnone on the harness. Not investigated; unrelated to clip.
